entries.source: January 9, 2024
Please read this first:
entries.ko: 먼저 다음 안내를 읽으세요.

entries.source: 1. The time available for the theoretical competition is 4 hours. There are three questions.
entries.ko: 1. 이론시험 시간은 4시간이며, 문제는 세 개입니다.

entries.source: 2. Use only the pen provided.
entries.ko: 2. 제공된 펜만 사용하세요.

entries.source: 3. You can use your own calculator for numerical calculations. If you don’t have one, please ask for it from Olympiad organizers.
entries.ko: 3. 수치 계산에 개인 계산기를 사용할 수 있습니다. 계산기가 없으면 대회 운영진에게 요청하세요.

entries.source: 4. You are provided with Writing sheet and additional paper. You can use the additional paper for drafts of your solutions but these papers will not be checked. Your final solutions which will be evaluated should be on the Writing sheets. Please use as little text as possible. You should mostly use equations, numbers, figures and plots.
entries.ko: 4. 답안지와 별도 용지가 제공됩니다. 별도 용지는 풀이의 초안에 사용할 수 있으나 채점하지 않습니다. 채점받을 최종 풀이는 답안지에 작성해야 합니다. 글은 가능한 한 적게 쓰고 주로 수식, 수치, 그림과 그래프로 답하세요.

entries.source: 5. Use only the front side of Writing sheets. Write only inside the boxed area.
entries.ko: 5. 답안지의 앞면만 사용하고, 테두리 안에만 쓰세요.

entries.source: 6. Begin each question on a separate sheet of paper.
entries.ko: 6. 각 문제는 별도의 새 답안지에서 시작하세요.

entries.source: 7. Fill the boxes at the top of each sheet of paper with your country (Country), your student code (Student Code), the question number (Question Number), the progressive number of each sheet (Page Number), and the total number of Writing sheets used (Total Number of Pages). If you use some blank Writing sheets for notes that you do not wish to be evaluated, put a large X across the entire sheet and do not include it in your numbering.
entries.ko: 7. 각 답안지 위의 칸에 국가(Country), 참가자 코드(Student Code), 문제 번호(Question Number), 답안지 순서(Page Number), 사용한 총 답안지 수(Total Number of Pages)를 기입하세요. 빈 답안지를 채점받지 않을 메모에 썼다면 전체에 크게 X를 표시하고 쪽수에 포함하지 마세요.

entries.source: 8. At the end of the exam, arrange all sheets for each problem in the following order: [[0]] Used Writing sheets in order. [[1]] The sheets you do not wish to be evaluated. [[2]] Unused sheets. [[3]] The printed problems. Place the papers inside the envelope and leave everything on your desk. You are not allowed to take any paper out of the room.
entries.ko: 8. 시험이 끝나면 문제별로 다음 순서로 정리하세요. [[0]] 사용한 답안지를 쪽수 순서대로 놓습니다. [[1]] 채점받지 않을 용지. [[2]] 사용하지 않은 용지. [[3]] 인쇄된 문제지. 모든 종이를 봉투 안에 넣고 책상 위에 두세요. 어떤 종이도 시험실 밖으로 가져갈 수 없습니다.

entries.source: Problem 1.1 (3.0 points) On two identical horizontal V-shaped slats (see figure below), forming a dihedral angle of [[0]] ([[1]]), there is a solid bicone with a base diameter of [[2]] cm and a distance between the vertices of [[3]] cm, representing two identical homogeneous cones, rigidly fastened by their bases. First, the bicone is held so that its center of mass is right above the vertex of the dihedral angle, symmetrically relative to its bisectoral plane. Then it is released and it begins to roll along the slats without slipping. Find the dependence of the bicone speed of translational motion of the [[4]] on the [[5]] coordinate measured horizontally from the vertex of the dihedral angle to the center of mass of the bicone. Calculate the speed of the bicone [[6]] at [[7]] cm. Determine the maximum angular velocity [[8]], that the bicone is to reach during its motion. Consider that the height of the slats exceeds the radius of the cone bases, and the acceleration of gravity is [[9]] m/c2.

entries.source: Problem 1.2 (4.0 points) A thermally insulated vessel with a volume of 2[[0]]0 = 2.00 l is divided by a thin weightless movable heat-conducting partition into two equal parts, each containing nitrogen [[1]] at a pressure [[2]] kPa. The initial temperature of nitrogen in one half of the vessel is [[3]]1 = 240 K, and it is [[4]]2 = 360 K in the other. As a result of heat exchange, the partition begins to move slowly without friction. 1) Determine the amount of heat [[5]] that will be exchanged between parts of the vessel by the time complete thermodynamic equilibrium is established; 2) Calculate the minimum work [[6]] that must be done to return the partition to its original position. Neglect the heat capacities of the vessel and partition.

entries.source: Lagrange points in a three-body system Lagrange points, libration points (Latin librātiō – swinging) or L-points are points in the space of a system of two massive bodies in which a third body with negligible mass, not affected by any other forces other than gravitational ones from the first two, can remain motionless relative to these bodies.
entries.ko: 삼체계의 라그랑주 점 / 라그랑주 점 또는 칭동점(L점; 라틴어 librātiō는 흔들림을 뜻함)은 두 무거운 물체의 계에서, 질량을 무시할 수 있는 세 번째 물체가 앞의 두 물체의 중력만 받을 때 이들에 대해 정지해 있을 수 있는 공간상의 점이다.

entries.source: SOHO is a solar observing spacecraft, a joint project of ESA and NASA, which was launched on December 2, 1995 and began operations in May 1996. entries.source: Problem 3. Geometric optics and photodetector (10.0 points) In this problem, the laws of geometric optics are to be studied using a photodetector, which is a device for converting light energy into electrical energy. It is assumed that the absorbing surface of the photodetector is flat and when it is connected to a milliammeter, it shows a current value proportional to the power of the absorbed electromagnetic radiation.
entries.ko:
문제 3. 기하광학과 광검출기 (10.0점)
이 문제에서는 빛에너지를 전기에너지로 바꾸는 광검출기로 기하광학 법칙을 연구한다. 광검출기의 흡수면은 평평하고, 밀리암페어 전류계에 연결하면 흡수한 전자기파 출력에 비례하는 전류를 표시한다고 하라.

entries.source: Geometric optics is a branch of optics that studies the laws of light propagation in transparent media, the reflection of light from mirror-reflecting surfaces, and the principles of constructing images when light passes through optical systems without taking into account its wave properties. The basic concept of geometric optics is a light beam. This implies that the direction of the flow of radiant energy (path of the light beam) does not depend on the transverse dimensions of the light beam. Let us recall the laws of geometric optics necessary for this problem solution.
entries.ko: 기하광학은 파동 성질을 고려하지 않고 투명 매질 속 빛의 전파, 거울면 반사, 광학계의 결상을 연구한다. 기본 개념은 광선으로, 복사에너지 흐름의 방향인 광선 경로는 빛줄기의 가로 크기에 의존하지 않는다. 풀이에 필요한 법칙들을 떠올려 보자.

entries.source: 3.1 When reflected from a flat surface, the incident and reflected rays lie in the same plane with the normal at the point of incidence. Let the incident ray make an angle [[0]] with the normal, and the reflected ray make an angle [[1]]. Write down the relationship between these angles.

entries.source: 3.2 When light falls from air onto a flat surface of a material with refractive index n, the incident and refracted rays also lie in the same plane with the normal at the point of incidence. Let the incident ray make an angle [[0]] with the normal, and the refracted ray make an angle [[1]]. Write down the relationship between these angles.
entries.ko: 3.2 빛이 공기에서 굴절률 n인 물질의 평면으로 들어갈 때 입사광선·굴절광선·입사점의 법선도 한 평면에 놓인다. 입사각 [[0]]와 굴절각 [[1]] 사이의 관계를 써라.

entries.source: In the following parts of this problem, we consider only situations in which, in the processes of light refraction, the above-mentioned angles are small and the approximation of paraxial optics holds.
entries.ko: 이후에는 굴절 과정에서 위 각들이 작아 근축광학 근사가 성립하는 경우만 다룬다.

entries.source: 3.3 Rewrite the answer to 3.2 in the case of small angles of incidence and refraction.
